question: On low-lying ground in six Dutch places, how close are Mapbox's DEM heights to AHN4's 0.5 m lidar DEM, at the point and averaged over Mapbox's pixel?

facts.fact: AHN's point height lies within its own one-pixel square's range at 95% of points or more
Every place has 90% of points within 0.5 m at the point, as read
Every place has 90% within 0.5 m once its median difference is removed
Every place has 90% within 0.5 m with AHN averaged over one pixel
